response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT si.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), all_statuses AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(sr.site_count) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(sr.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a WHERE sr.rate > a.avg_rate;
